#Figure 3: This R-Markdown is for the code that will be used for figure 3. Figure 3 is going to be about the LA analysis in endometriosis and endometrioma

## Library loading 
```{r ,message = FALSE}
library(cowplot)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(gdata)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggrepel)
library(beeswarm)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r include=FALSE}
getwd()

setwd("/media/Data01/Marcela/sc_endo_la_immune")
```


#Loading excel file that is needed for Beeswarm plots and statistics
```{r}
#endometrioma vs Endometriosis LA by part
LA.simple.data = read_xlsx("data/2024-11-06_Combine_scGroup_withPriority2_analyze_only_endometriosis_positive_parts_deidentified_Rfile.xlsx", sheet = 5)
LA.simple.data <- LA.simple.data %>% filter(!grepl("No ", Category))
```


#fold more LA in endometriosis than PE
```{R}
LA.simple.data %>%
       select(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates, Category) %>% 
       group_by(Category) %>% 
       summarise(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates = sum(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates))

#take the number under Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates for Endometriosis and divide by the number for Endometrioma
```


#figure 3B Beeswarm plot, group ALL endometrioma and ALL peritoneal so 2 violins, Plot is by part
```{r}
#Statistics comparing number of LA in Endometioma vs Endometrioma in each part. So some patients will have multiple parts
wilcox.test(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates ~ Category, data = LA.simple.data)

p1 <- ggplot(LA.simple.data, aes(x=Category, y=Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates)) + 
  geom_quasirandom(size=2.5) + 
  geom_text(x=0.75, y=30, label="p-value = 0.2499", colour="black", family = "san", fontface = "plain", size =5) +
  ggtitle("Number of LA in each Endometrioma and Endometriosis part") + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 20)

p1

#pdf(file = "Results/Fig3B_LA_Endo_vs_PE_by_part.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
p1
dev.off()
```


#Fig3C LA by patients and showing the cut off of LA yes/no
```{R}
#Number of LA in Endometrioma and Endometriosis by patient with patients labeled
LA.summarised <- LA.simple.data %>%
  select(`PAPER ID`, Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates, Category) %>% 
  group_by(`PAPER ID`, Category) %>% 
  summarise(total_lymph_agg = sum(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates)) %>% 
  mutate(plotting_id = paste0(`PAPER ID`, Category))

LA.summarised$plotting_id <- factor(LA.summarised$plotting_id, levels = LA.summarised$plotting_id[order(LA.summarised$total_lymph_agg)])

wilcox.test(total_lymph_agg ~ Category, data = LA.summarised)
```
